metadata.description: A rich 4-line statusline for Claude Code with git context, session metrics, cache efficiency, compaction hints, tools, agents and skills

plugins.name: claudebar
plugins.description: A 4-line statusline for Claude Code. Line 1: git branch with dirty state, ahead commits, insertions/deletions and last commit. Line 2: model, context bar with in/out tokens, session rate limits with countdown, and a compaction indicator. Line 3: session duration, cache hit rate, lines edited by Claude, and tool usage. Line 4: agents and skills used in the session.
